description: This file defines the SiteConfigureForm class, a Drupal form used for site configuration during installation, including site info, admin account setup, regional settings, and update notifications.

classes.name: SiteConfigureForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring site settings during installation, handling form building, validation, and submission.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies and configuration parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getEditableConfigNames
methods.description: Returns configuration names that can be edited by this form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the site configuration form with fields for site info, admin account, regional settings, and update notifications.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saves configuration, installs update module if needed, and creates the admin user.

methods.name: getAdminRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles marked as admin roles.
